rationale: The protobuf schema change from float32 to double (float64) requires explicit handling of numeric precision in TypeScript/JavaScript. No changes are needed for the protobuf-generated types or the protobuf wire format handling since TypeScript's `number` type already maps to binary64 (float64) in protobuf, matching the new schema.
